meta.source: illuminationhealthhome.org Elementor global kit + IHH design brief, captured 2026-10-17

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Sunflower Yellow, the signature color. Fills only: primary CTAs, the utility bar, service card (Housing), story-card footers, newsletter band. As text, only on navy, indigo or a scrimmed photo (headline keywords, stat numbers). Never text on white (1.53:1). Logo files use #FACC10; treat as the same color.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: Illumination Indigo, the second block color: Healthcare service card, ticker band, outline buttons on indigo. White text on it 13.0:1; yellow on it 8.5:1.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Midnight Navy: default text and headings on white, sand and yellow; the header bar, GET HELP button, dark sections. 15.3:1 on white, 12.3:1 on sand, 9.95:1 on yellow.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Warm Sand: soft section backgrounds (testimonials, rest areas between white sections). Navy and charcoal text read on it.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Page background; text on navy, indigo and scrimmed photos.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Secondary body text on white (12.0:1) and sand (9.6:1).

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Base of the photo scrim only. Not a text color; text is navy.

tokens.name: logo-indigo
tokens.usage: Wordmark color in IHH-Logo-Variant-2 on light grounds. Logo use only; never a UI color.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: 50% black overlay on every photo that carries white text (hero, impact stats).

tokens.name: navy-glass
tokens.usage: Fill of the ghost button on photos (MORE ABOUT US). Always over a scrimmed photo.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Semantic: page background.

tokens.name: bg-soft
tokens.usage: Semantic: alternate section background.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Semantic: body copy and headings on bg, bg-soft and accent.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Semantic: secondary copy on bg and bg-soft.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Semantic: primary action fill and signature blocks.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Semantic: text and icons on accent. Never white on yellow.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Semantic: secondary block color.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Semantic: text and borders on primary.

tokens.name: dark
tokens.usage: Semantic: dark bars and sections (header, footer-less dark bands).

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Semantic: text on dark and on scrimmed photos.

tokens.name: highlight-on-dark
tokens.usage: Semantic: the 1–2 highlighted headline words and stat numbers, on dark, primary or a scrimmed photo only.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: 2px solid keyboard focus outline, offset 2px, on white, sand and yellow grounds (≥9.9:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring-on-dark
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: focus outline on navy, indigo and photo grounds (≥8.5:1).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: IvyPresto Display 700 on the live site (Adobe Fonts, licensed). Playfair Display 700 is the shipped stand-in. Sentence case. Emotion only: headlines, quotes, numbers.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: We build the bridge between survival and stability.
styles.usage: H1 and hero headline (40–60px responsive). One per page.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: From crisis to stability, one step at a time.
styles.usage: Section headings. 34px on the home page.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Impact numbers, in highlight-on-dark over a dark or scrimmed ground.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: “I didn’t think I would come out of this on track and with my own apartment.”
styles.usage: Testimonial pull quotes, navy on sand. Curly quotes always.

styles.name: quote-sm
styles.usage: Pull quotes on mobile or in narrow columns.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Archivo for everything functional. Uppercase styles (eyebrow, button, nav, label-lg) set text-transform: uppercase in the component.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We meet people where they are and walk with them toward new possibilities.
styles.usage: Running text. 14px on the home page.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: Stability starts with a roof—and grows from there.
styles.usage: Lead sentence that opens a card or paragraph.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side gutter of the content column at every width.

tokens.name: card-pad-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding inside service and content cards.

tokens.name: card-pad-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside service and content cards.

tokens.name: section-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a standard section.

tokens.name: hero-top
tokens.usage: Top padding of the hero on desktop (under the sticky header).

tokens.name: btn-pad-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of standard buttons.

tokens.name: btn-pad-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of standard buttons.

tokens.name: btn-sm-pad-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of small and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: btn-sm-pad-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of small and ghost buttons.

radius.note: Square everywhere. This is a defining trait.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Every button, card, image and input. The only exception is the round carousel arrow buttons.

shadow.note: No shadows. Depth comes from color blocks and photo scrims.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Everything.

border.note: Solid, navy or white, never grey.

tokens.name: border-thin
tokens.usage: Dark button border, underline inputs.

tokens.name: border-thick
tokens.usage: Outline buttons (LEARN MORE, JOIN).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the content column.

tokens.name: text-max
tokens.usage: Max width of centered intro copy.
